## [Unreleased]

<!-- This file is auto-generated by git-cliff during releases. -->
<!-- Manual entries in [Unreleased] will be replaced on release. -->

### Added

- Linear credentials can now be scoped per linked repo, enabling setups like `repo-a -> Linear A` and `repo-b -> Linear B`.

### Changed

- `isq link linear` now supports `-o team=...`, `-o list-teams`, and `-o reauth` for explicit workspace/account binding.
- `isq logout linear` now clears both global and scoped Linear credentials.
